content_sections.text: The Manipur Police Headquarters notification dated 2 November 2026 contains the post-wise vacancy breakup, pay levels, reservation details, application form instructions and provisions for candidates who applied under earlier notifications. content_sections.heading: Manipur Police Vacancy 2026 – Post-Wise Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2,698 posts have been announced across 19 recruitment categories. Constable (Male/Civil) has the highest number of vacancies at 1,200 posts, followed by Riflemen with 280 posts and Follower with 250 posts. The vacancies are provisional and may increase or decrease depending on the decision of the State Government. The 250 Follower vacancies are distributed across 10 trades. Candidates interested in these posts can check the trade-wise details below.

content_sections.heading: Manipur Police Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The recruitment is open to willing and eligible candidates for the notified posts. However, the uploaded notification does not provide detailed post-wise educational qualifications, age limits or physical measurement standards. Applicants should obtain the prescribed recruitment instructions and confirm the specific eligibility requirements for their chosen post from the concerned District SP office or official Manipur Police website. This provision applies to eligible applicants under the earlier recruitment notifications dated 14 July 2021, 17 October 2022 and 13 March 2024, as identified in the new notification.

content_sections.heading: Manipur Police Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: Manipur Police has prescribed a fee of Rs. 400 per application form . Eligible Persons with Disabilities candidates are exempted from paying the application fee. The forms are available from the offices of the concerned District Superintendents of Police during office hours.

rows.category: Applicants other than eligible PwD candidates

content_sections.heading: Manipur Police Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The salary structure varies according to the post. The notification specifies pay levels under the Revised Pay Rules (ROP) 2019 but does not provide individual monthly basic-pay amounts in rupees.

content_sections.heading: Manipur Police Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The notification mentions a Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Written Test as part of the recruitment process. Their dates and times will be announced separately by the department. Detailed post-wise test patterns, qualifying standards, marks and any additional selection stages have not been specified in the uploaded notification. Candidates should follow further official announcements for complete selection procedures.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Manipur Police Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The Manipur Police Recruitment 2026 application process is offline. Applicants must obtain the prescribed form from their concerned District Superintendent of Police office and follow the official application and Employment Exchange sponsorship requirements. Visit the office of the concerned District Superintendent of Police during office hours. Obtain the prescribed application form for the appropriate recruitment post. Pay the application form fee of Rs. 400, unless eligible for the notified PwD exemption. Complete the prescribed application form with accurate information. Follow the instructions provided by the concerned authorities regarding the required documents, form submission and Employment Exchange sponsorship. Confirm the applicable individual submission deadline with the concerned authorities.

content_sections.heading: Manipur Police Recruitment 2026 Reservation Details
content_sections.text: The notification provides category-wise vacancies under UR, SC, ST and the applicable OBC categories. Candidates should check the post-wise reservation distribution in Annexure I. The announced 2,698 vacancies exclude the seats under the separate 20% horizontal reservation for Ex-Agniveers and 5% horizontal reservation for meritorious sportspersons. Two Lower Division Clerk vacancies are specified as horizontally reserved for PwD candidates within the notified LDC allocation.

content_sections.heading: Manipur Police Recruitment 2026 Application Form
content_sections.text: The prescribed application forms are available at the concerned District Superintendent of Police offices during office hours. The notification does not prescribe an online application portal for this recruitment. Applicants should confirm the individual submission process and relevant deadlines through their concerned District SP office and Employment Exchange.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in Manipur Police Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Manipur Police has announced 2,698 vacancies across 19 post categories, including Constable, SI, ASI, Riflemen and other positions.

faq.question: Q2. When was the Manipur Police Recruitment 2026 notification released?
faq.answer: The notification was issued by Manipur Police Headquarters on 2 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Manipur Police Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification specifies 20 December 2026 for Employment Exchange-sponsored candidate lists to reach Police Headquarters. It does not specify an individual application closing date.

faq.question: Q4. How many Constable vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are 1,200 Constable (Male/Civil), 200 Constable (Female/Civil), 172 Constable Driver and 10 Constable (Fitter) vacancies, making 1,582 Constable posts across these four categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for Manipur Police Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The prescribed application form fee is Rs. 400. Eligible PwD candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q6. Is the Manipur Police Recruitment 2026 application online or offline?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Forms are available at the concerned District Superintendent of Police offices during office hours.

faq.question: Q7. What is the educational qualification for Manipur Police Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The uploaded notification does not specify detailed post-wise educational qualifications. Candidates must refer to the prescribed eligibility instructions for their chosen post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Manipur Police Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification mentions a Physical Efficiency Test and Written Test. The detailed schedule and test requirements will be notified separately.

faq.question: Q9. Do candidates who applied under earlier notifications need to apply again?
faq.answer: No. Applications previously submitted and duly sponsored by the Employment Exchange under the specified 2021, 2022 and 2024 notifications will remain valid.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates get the Manipur Police Recruitment 2026 application form?
faq.answer: Candidates can obtain the prescribed application forms from their concerned District Superintendent of Police offices during office hours.
